content.full_text: Dr BR Ambedkar Jayanti 2024  Rayapuram Moulaiah Naidu Associate Lawyer (Gadwal District Telangana State) on the occasion of Ambedkar Jayanti laid floral wreaths and Dr BR Ambedkar as the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constitution of India handed over the Constitution of India to the future generations Let's obey, Rayapuram Moulaiah Naidu Associate Lawyer, and  praised the services of Dr BR Ambedkar.
